scope: Selected candidates from eight-repeat tuning screens on layer-zero real activations; not independent confirmation. Only custom Cubic/S1/S2 projections were timed in isolation; Native screening used the whole layer. Never use Native whole-layer timing as an isolated-GEMM baseline.
